description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Pinnacle Monk // Mystic Peak.
Resolve Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Pinnacle Monk // Mystic Peak from exile to the battlefield.
When Pinnacle Monk // Mystic Peak enters, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
